body.purpose: Default Chinese-first application copy and controls.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for cards and statistics panels.

shadows.name: hero
shadows.purpose: Raised emphasis for the home hero card.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Short, restrained transitions for navigation, page changes, and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for progressing through a learning workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #409eff; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #337ecc; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #409eff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action for account and secondary controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: transparent; color: #606266; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #dcdfe6; border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: #409eff; background: #ecf5ff; border-color: #a0cfff; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #409eff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Icon-led workspace navigation with an active learning section.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #606266; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible, .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: #409eff; background: #ecf5ff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #409eff; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: White bordered surface for study summaries and task content.
components.html:
本周学习

继续保持稳定节奏。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #303133; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e4e7ed; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #606266; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Soft metadata treatment for filters, tags, and quiet links.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 20px; background: #f5f7fa; color: #606266; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #ecf5ff; color: #409eff; }

components.name: Daily Word
components.description: A compact vocabulary cue shown in the expanded sidebar.
components.css: .ds-daily-word { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #e4e7ed; border-radius: 13px; background: #fafafa; } .ds-daily-word small { color: #606266; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-daily-word strong { color: #303133; font-size: 19px; } .ds-daily-word span { color: #909399; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: LearningProgram is a calm, utility-first workspace built on Element Plus primitives. A cool neutral canvas, white work surfaces, one blue action color, compact labels, and generous gutters keep a broad learning product understandable. The interface should feel dependable and encouraging rather than competitive or promotional.
keyCharacteristics: Chinese-first system typography with an Inter fallback.
Cool neutral page canvas with white elevated surfaces.
Blue accent for action, active navigation, and learning emphasis.
Compact rounded geometry with light borders and restrained shadows.
Responsive application shell with desktop rail and mobile drawer.

rules.name: Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Consume Element Plus semantic variables so light and dark themes stay synchronized.

rules.name: Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep blue as the single dominant action color; use semantic colors only for status.

rules.name: Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer page/background contrast and light borders before adding shadows.

dos: Do use white surfaces, light borders, and tonal layering to establish hierarchy.
Do preserve responsive navigation and clear authenticated states.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand accent without an explicit product decision.
Don't hard-code light-mode values where an Element Plus semantic variable exists.
